root_cause.layer_1_markup: the live HTML's img tag carries a full srcset/sizes attribute set the local render does not: LiteSpeed Cache 7.9.2 (active on production only, absent on review) rewrites the template's img tags server-side
root_cause.layer_2_negotiation: with sizes=(max-width:600px) 120vw, 2400px at viewport 1440 the live browser selects the 2048w candidate, and the CDN answers a browser Accept header with a content-negotiated 2400x1593 encoding; curl without that header receives the identical 2048x1360 bytes (md5 75a0d67... matches local)
root_cause.mechanism: the SAME image file (same URL, same md5, same 74284 bytes on disk both sides) decodes to 2400x1593 in the live browser and 2048x1360 in the local browser at 1440; at 390 live serves the -768x510 srcset variant while local serves the full file
root_cause.consequence: object-fit:cover crops the differently-proportioned decode into a 21px taller story card at de-1440 (size fail) and shifts cover crops across the testimonials band on every page; it is NOT a content or code difference
